status_werte.exact: every oscillator, filter, envelope, modulation and voice value of the card is built; the effect order is kept; only bell-EQ moves and values the card leaves open are engineering choices (listed in naeherung)
status_werte.approximated: something on the card is replaced by a substitute (listed in naeherung); exakt_mit names the module that would make it exact, null when no module of the parallel work does
status_werte.blocked: the card's defining module does not exist; the patch is a stand-in

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 443
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (there is no free-running sine oscillator, the kit's sine exists only as the FM carrier; use triangle for the fundamental and a sine-FM carrier with index 0 as the clean layer).

beschreibung.text: Clean mono sub: sine plus a quiet triangle an octave up under a 12 dB low-pass that tracks the note.

naeherung: The card asks for a sine-FM carrier because it assumed no free-running sine; the kit's `sinus` block is one, so the sine is used directly.
Saturation sits before the low-pass so its harmonics are filtered with the rest.

patches.zitat: DNB Academy [W], “[quote omitted]”, updated 22 Oct 2026
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (two saws + ladder/SVF notch + LFO is exactly the kit).

beschreibung.text: Dark DnB reese: two saws detuned +-38 cent, tube drive and a slowly moving notch, legato with glide.

naeherung: Two detuned saws are one wavetable node with 2 unison copies at +-38 cent, so the patch costs one voice.
Chorus 'on the mids only': the signal is split at 150 Hz, the lows stay mono and dry, the rest goes through the chorus.
'Short hall on the highs': the hall's low-band decay factor is 0.3, so lows die fast in the tail.
The card's multiband compressor is a single-band compressor (no multiband block).

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 95, patch Acid Bass, table transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (pulse + square + ladder 24 dB + resonance 60 % + drive).

beschreibung.text: Squelchy acid bass: square plus 25 % pulse into a 24 dB ladder at 450 Hz with 60 % resonance, drive and slide.

naeherung: Welsh writes the square at -2 oct under the pulse; here the square sits on the played note and the pulse two octaves above it.
Knob 3 is the card's substitute for hand automation: a 0.3 Hz LFO on the cutoff, off at the midpoint (+-12 st at the ends).

patches.zitat: Cann [B4] p. 110, patch FM Bass
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (the kit has one sine-FM pair, not a five-operator stack: op 1 ← op 2 reproduces the body, the second modulator that adds the metallic edge is lost).

beschreibung.text: Punchy FM bass: three sine operators sharing one 2 s exponential decay, so the brightness falls with the note.

naeherung: Three operators from `sinus` blocks with linear FM (the card assumed one FM pair; the kit can stack sines).
Cann's operator levels (mod level 60) have no defined index; both modulators run at index 1.5 at the knob midpoint, my choice.
Pitches keep the card's intervals with op 3 (the lowest sounding operator) on the played note: op 1 +12 st, op 2 -7 st.
patches.exakt_mit: FM operators (several operators with ratios, per-operator envelopes and calibrated levels)

patches.zitat: KAN Samples [W], “[quote omitted]”, 22 May 2026
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (saw/pulse + ladder + LFO with tempo sync; the sub layer costs one more voice per note).

beschreibung.text: Dubstep wobble: detuned saws under a resonant ladder swept by a tempo-synced LFO, with a clean sine sub.

naeherung: The card's compressor is sidechained to the kick; a patch has no kick, so the compressor runs without a key.
The wobble is a beat-synced LFO (1/8 note, `takt` 0.5) between 200 Hz and 2.5 kHz; the sync division is a fixed value, not a knob.
The saws are one wavetable node with 3 copies at +-8 cent; the clean sine sub joins after the filter.

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 294
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (square + saw, ladder, ADSR used as AR, glide, drive, chorus).

beschreibung.text: Warm analog bass: saw and square an octave apart, open ladder, AR envelope, drive, compression and a light chorus.

naeherung: Detroit Bass variant [B1] p. 96: saw on the played note, square an octave above, ladder fully open, AR envelope, glide 10 ms.
The chorus mix knob is the FX-bus send: dry plus wet, so the dry weight survives.
The cutoff knob reaches 20 kHz at its midpoint (the card's open filter); above the midpoint the ladder is clamped at 0.45 sr.

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 443
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (saw/pulse + ladder + ADSR + compressor with sidechain input; if the kit's compressor has no key input, use the gate inverted by a kick-triggered envelope, Näherung).

beschreibung.text: Rolling 16th-note bass: detuned saws an octave over a sine sub, plucked by a fast filter envelope, ends before the next 16th.

naeherung: The kick sidechain (ratio 9:1, attack 5 ms, release 200 ms) is a plain compressor with those times: a patch has no kick input.
'A quarter open' is 25 % on Welsh's scale (113 Hz) and 'D quarter' is 0.18 s; 'moderate' env amount is 40 % (48 st).
The two detuned saws are one wavetable node (2 copies, +-6 cent) an octave above a sine sub on the played note.

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 444
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar.

beschreibung.text: Tight plucked bass: unison saws through a ladder opened by a short, deep filter envelope, no sustain.

naeherung: Unison saws: one wavetable node with 4 copies at +-12 cent (one voice).
Resonance 50 %, env amount 85 % and amp decay 0.29 s from the parallel Welsh Funk Bass table the card cites.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 91, patch Mellow 70's Lead, table transcribed. Glide rationale: Reid [B2] part 18
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (2 pulse/saw, ladder open, glide, 1 voice).

beschreibung.text: Mellow 70s mono lead: two squares 10 cent apart, open filter, fast 20 ms glide, overdrive, eighth delay and short hall.

naeherung: The two squares at -10/+10 cent are one wavetable node (`rechteck` at width 50 %, 2 copies, +-10 cent).

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 91, patch Brass Section, table transcribed; polyphony note: Reid [B2] part 20
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (2 voices per note → 8 notes within 16 voices).

beschreibung.text: Brassy poly lead: two pulse waves with 5.5 Hz PWM, a fast-opening ladder, chorus, eighth delay and hall.

naeherung: Brass Section [B1] p. 91: the 100 % filter envelope (120 st) opens the 40 Hz ladder fully in 30 ms and holds it open.
PWM depth 45 % is read as a pulse-width swing of +-20 % (pwm input 0.45).

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 447
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (3 saws per note → a 5-note chord uses 15 of 16 voices; a 7-saw supersaw is not reachable without voice stealing).

beschreibung.text: Trance supersaw: seven detuned saws in one voice, spread wide, hall with pre-delay, gated tail and a short delay.

naeherung: The card's voice problem is gone: 7 detuned saws are one wavetable node (7 copies), so a note costs one voice and 8 notes fit.
'As far apart as possible without separating' is 25 cent for the outermost copy at the knob midpoint (my choice).
Gate after the hall (threshold -40 dBFS) cuts the tail; the optional parallel compression is left out.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 95 (Acid Bass); the octave lift is derived, the rest is the table as printed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar.

beschreibung.text: Acid lead: the 303-style acid bass lifted an octave, 60 % resonance, tube drive and a dotted 16th delay.

naeherung: The acid bass patch with every oscillator one octave up (the card's derived lift); tube drive instead of the bass's tanh drive.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 93, patch Screaming Sync
patches.machbarkeit_karte: fehlt: Hard-Sync (no sync-capable oscillator in the kit). Nearest approximation: pulse with heavy pitch-LFO + bitcrusher, which gives the edge but not the harmonic jump.

beschreibung.text: Screaming sync lead: a square hard-synced to a silent master, tuned up, with slow 4.5 cent vibrato and light drive.

naeherung: The card says hard sync is missing; the kit's oscillators have had a `sync` input since slice 1 (`zyklus` of a master into `sync`), so the patch uses it.
That sync smooths only the half of the step after the reset, so a fast sync sweep aliases; a band-limited sync oscillator would remove it.
Unison is a second master/slave pair 8 cent up. The card gives no osc 2 offset; +7 st at the knob midpoint is my choice (an integer ratio would hide the sync).

patches.zitat: Reid [B2] part 13
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (single carrier–modulator pair: 1:1 and integer ratios work, cascaded 4-operator timbres do not).

beschreibung.text: Digital FM lead: sine carrier with a 1:2 modulator whose index jumps at the attack and settles, velocity sets the bite.

naeherung: Carrier on the played note, modulator at 1:2. Index 1 at sustain plus an attack envelope adding 3 (the bite), scaled by velocity.
Amp envelope A 5 ms, D 1.2 s, S 45 %, R 0.3 s inside the card's ranges; optional 12 dB low-pass at 9 kHz included.
besser_mit: FM operators (several operators with ratios, per-operator envelopes and calibrated levels)

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 438
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar für den Klang; die Arpeggiator-Funktion selbst fehlt im Baukasten (Noten müssen von außen kommen).

beschreibung.text: Bright arp lead: saw and pulse with a short filter blip, high-passed off the bass, tempo-synced 16th delay.

naeherung: The kit has no arpeggiator: the notes must come from the host, as the card says. The sound is complete.
Saw plus 30 % pulse 7 cent up; filter envelope D 0.12 s; 24 dB high-pass at 300 Hz (the card gives no slope); delay damped at 3 kHz ('filtered').

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 437–438
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (the kit has both waveforms, detune, chorus, phaser and hall; watch the 16-voice budget).

beschreibung.text: String section: triangle and detuned squares under a mid-resonance ladder that opens slowly after the bow, chorus, phaser, hall.

naeherung: Triangle plus a square detuned 4 cent; the 'second layer detuned further' is a wavetable square with 3 copies at +-12 cent.
Pitch LFO 0.4 Hz, 8 cent on the square; cutoff LFO 0.15 Hz, +-3 st; filter envelope A 0.8 s, D 0.6 s, S 70 %, R 0.6 s.
The optional sidechain compression from a rhythmic element is left out (no key source in a patch).

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 77, patch Choir, table transcribed. Formant numbers: Reid [B2] part 23
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (the pulse/LFO patch is exact; real vowels need three band-passes per note, the kit's SVF can do it, the vocoder is the cheaper route, but the vowel source must be sampled or synthesized).

beschreibung.text: Synth choir: two scattered pulse layers with slow vibrato and swell, a formant band-pass bank, strong chorus and long hall.

naeherung: Welsh Choir exact: pulses at 15 % and 25 % (the second -2 oct), 24 dB ladder at 1.7 kHz, A 0.32 / R 0.93 s, 2.4 Hz 20 cent vibrato.
Each pulse is a wavetable `rechteck` with 3 copies at +-6 cent, the card's 'pitch scatter per voice for a section'.
Vowel: three SVF band-passes at 640 / 1200 / 2400 Hz (the card's last formant set) crossfade with the low-pass (knob 2); one fixed vowel, no vowel morph.
The EQ cut 1-3 kHz is not built (no bell EQ block).

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 99, patch Celestial Wash
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (noise + ladder at 100 % resonance + LFO + hall is the kit's strongest combination).

beschreibung.text: Celestial wash: noise rings a self-oscillating, key-tracked ladder pulsed at 5.5 Hz, slow swell, very long hall.

naeherung: Celestial Wash [B1] p. 99: noise into a self-oscillating ladder (resonance 100 %), the 5.5 Hz square LFO switches the resonance 0..1.
Keyboard tracking on: cutoff = 3.82 x note frequency (1 kHz at C4).

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 101, patches Galactic Cathedral and Galactic Chapel, tables transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (2 squares, ladder, slow LFO, long release).

beschreibung.text: Analog pad: two squares two octaves apart under a resonant ladder that breathes at 0.3 Hz, long release, chorus, phaser, hall.

naeherung: Galactic Cathedral [B1] p. 101: squares at -11 cent and +2 oct +11 cent, ladder 1.2 kHz / 60 %, 0.3 Hz LFO on the cutoff, R 2.25 s.
LFO depth 10 % is read as +-6 st (one octave peak to peak). The Galactic Chapel amplitude LFO (17 %) is left out.

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 138
patches.machbarkeit_karte: fehlt: Granular-Engine (the sampler can play grains only as fixed slices; a true grain cloud needs a granular module).

beschreibung.text: Stand-in for a granular pad: a slowly scanned, randomly jittered wavetable cloud with long hall and chorus.

naeherung: Stand-in, not a granular pad: the kit has no grain engine. A wavetable (`analog`, 4 frames) with 5 copies stands in for the grain cloud.
'Grain position' is the wavetable position, moved by a 0.07 Hz LFO plus a random LFO (S&H, 3 Hz) smoothed over 80 ms; grain size has no equivalent.
Low-pass 3.8 kHz after the source, amp A 1 s / S 90 % / R 2.5 s, hall (very long) then chorus, as on the card.
patches.exakt_mit: granular engine (grain size, position, density, random scatter)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 102, patch Portus, table transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (2 triangles, resonant ladder, 1.5 s glide, long hall).

beschreibung.text: Dark drone bed: two triangles an octave apart under a resonant ladder that opens over two seconds, long glide and hall.

naeherung: Portus [B1] p. 102: triangles at 0 and +1 oct, ladder 75 Hz / 70 % with env 70 % (84 st), amp A 1.5 / R 3.3 s, filter A 1.8 / R 2.9 s.
Glide 1.5 s per voice (`glatt` 1.5 s): in a poly patch a voice glides from the last note it played.
Optional slow filter drift added: 0.1 Hz, +-2 st.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 76, patch Piano, table transcribed. Envelope logic: Cann [B4] p. 19
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (a synthesized piano is recognisable at best; without a sample library the attack transients and the unison-string beating are missing).

beschreibung.text: Synth piano: saw and synced pulse whose filter brightness decays with the note, velocity sets the touch, short room.

naeherung: Welsh Piano: saw 75 % plus a 15 % pulse at +1 oct +2 st hard-synced to the saw, ladder 40 Hz with env 75 % (90 st) and D 5.22 s.
Velocity scales the filter envelope (the card's touch). The EQ cut at 200-400 Hz is not built (no bell EQ block).
A synthesized piano: no hammer transient and no string beating, as the card says; a physical string model would add them.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 74, patch Electric Piano, table transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (sync-free kits lose the tine: substitute FM, carrier + modulator at 3:1 with fast mod-envelope decay).

beschreibung.text: Electric piano: saw and synced thin pulse for the tine, velocity bark, long decay to silence, chorus, phaser, room.

naeherung: Welsh Electric Piano: saw plus a 5 % pulse at +2 oct +9 st, synced (the kit has sync, so the card's FM substitute is not needed).
Ladder 630 Hz, env 50 % (60 st) with D 0.33 s, scaled by velocity (the bark); amp D 5.14 s to silence.
A tine model (FM operators or a modal resonator) would give a truer bell attack.
besser_mit: FM operators (several operators with ratios, per-operator envelopes and calibrated levels)
modal resonator (bank of tuned resonant modes)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 75, patch Organ, table transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (triangles = 8' and 16'; drawbar partials need one voice per partial, 4 partials × 4 notes = 16 voices, so polyphony is the limit).

beschreibung.text: Two-triangle organ: 8' and 16' with a slow click-free attack, rotary-style chorus and tremolo, tube warmth, short room.

naeherung: Welsh Organ: triangles at 0 and -2 oct, no filter, A 0.6 s, R 0.4 s, no velocity.
Rotary = chorus plus a 6.5 Hz tremolo (depth 20 % at the knob midpoint); the drawbar variant could use the `orgel` wavetable instead.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] pp. 82–83, patches Glockenspiel and Marimba, tables transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (two triangles, short decay, LFO tremolo).

beschreibung.text: Glockenspiel: two triangles at an inharmonic +2 oct +6 st, a bright filter tick, 1.2 s decay, plate and a soft 16th delay.

naeherung: Glockenspiel [B1] p. 82: triangles at 0 and +2 oct +6 st, ladder 3.8 kHz with env 75 % (90 st) D 0.1 s, amp D 1.2 / R 1.2 s, no sustain.
Room/plate 1.1 s, then high-pass 200 Hz, then a low 1/16 delay, as on the card.
besser_mit: modal resonator (bank of tuned resonant modes)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 94, patch Trance 5th, table transcribed; interval logic: Cann [B4] p. 55
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (2 voices per key, unison doubles it again → ~4 keys within 16 voices).

beschreibung.text: Stacked fifth chord: two PWM squares a fifth apart with unison, hard gate envelope, chorus, eighth delay and short hall.

naeherung: Trance 5th: squares on the root and +7 st, each a wavetable `rechteck` with 2 unison copies (+-10 cent); open filter, hard gated R.
PWM 6 Hz / 80 %: the wavetable position swings the width 50 % -> 14 % and back (same spectrum as +-36 % around 50 %).
The kick sidechain on the compressor is a plain compressor (no key in a patch).

patches.zitat: Cann [B4] p. 135, patch Another Bell
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (one FM pair reproduces the 1:7 ring, not four carriers with individual decay and detune).

beschreibung.text: FM bell: four sine carriers, three rung by one 1:7 modulator that dies in a second, detuned for beating, long ring.

naeherung: Cann Another Bell: one modulator at 7x (C:M 1:7, decay 1 s) on three of four sine carriers (amounts 47 / 74 / 100 %), carriers at 0, -32 and +16 cent.
Carrier decays 7 s, the third carrier 1.2 s ('just over 1 s'); velocity scales carrier and modulator levels.
The index scale (2.5 at amount 100 %) is my choice: Cann's synth defines its own level curve, which a calibrated FM operator block would reproduce.
patches.exakt_mit: FM operators (several operators with ratios, per-operator envelopes and calibrated levels)
besser_mit: modal resonator (bank of tuned resonant modes)

patches.zitat: Cann [B4] p. 217, patch Thin
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (SVF in band-pass mode + short envelope + velocity routing).

beschreibung.text: Thin synth pluck: a combed pulse through a resonant 2 kHz band-pass with a fast envelope, velocity on the cutoff, gated verb.

naeherung: Cann 'Thin': a pulse of width 1/3 (every third harmonic missing, a comb-like spectrum) into a 12 dB band-pass at 2 kHz, resonance 32 %.
Filter env D 91 ms, S 7/127, R 142 ms, amount 58/127 of 48 st (22 st); velocity -> cutoff 100 % is 24 st per unit velocity below full.
'8-tap/gated reverb' is the hall followed by a gate.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] pp. 83–84, patches Marimba and Xylophone, tables transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (triangles + short decay + tremolo; the wooden attack transient is a near-miss without samples).

beschreibung.text: Wooden xylophone: two triangles at +1 oct +10 st, a filter envelope for the strike, 1.9 s decay with light tremolo.

naeherung: Xylophone [B1] p. 84: triangles at 0 and +1 oct +10 st, ladder 300 Hz with env 60 % (72 st) and D 0.53 s, amp D 1.88 / R 1.78 s.
Tremolo 7.5 Hz, depth 5 % (bar ringing).
besser_mit: modal resonator (bank of tuned resonant modes)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 55, patch Guitar Acoustic, table transcribed; harp variant p. 56.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (sync-free kit: replace the sync transient with a 3–8 ms noise burst + a fast filter-envelope; a Karplus-Strong resonator needs delay time = 1/f, which the kit's delay can do but not pitch-tracked).

beschreibung.text: Plucked string: synced pulse pair with a noise pick and a falling filter, 1.7 s decay, light chorus and room.

naeherung: Guitar Acoustic [B1] p. 55: 25 % pulse master and a 10 % pulse at +10 st synced to it (the kit has sync), ladder 3.1 kHz, env 70 %.
The pick: a 5 ms noise burst (the card's 'very short noise burst'); amp D 1.7 / R 1.7 s.
The bell EQ cut at 300-500 Hz is not built. A physical string (Karplus-Strong) block would make the string itself.

patches.zitat: Cann [B4] p. 44, patches Bass + Stab and Gentle Stab
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (2 oscillators, ladder, ADSR×2 if the kit's filter accepts two mod sources; otherwise resonance is set statically, Näherung).

beschreibung.text: House stab: two detuned saws with a snappy filter, velocity brightness, resonance blip on the attack, short room.

naeherung: Velocity -> cutoff (24 st per unit below full velocity) and a second envelope on the resonance (+0.5, D 80 ms) as on the card.
Key scaling is linear in Hz (the kit has no logarithm block): -0.03 st per Hz above C4, so upper octaves are cut away.
The kick sidechain is left out (no key in a patch).

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 440–441
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (sine-FM carrier at index 0, pitch envelope, fast amp decay, saturation, compressor).

beschreibung.text: Punchy kick: a sine with a fast exponential pitch drop, short body, noise click, saturation and compression.

naeherung: Drum pitch is fixed (tune knob, F2 87 Hz at the midpoint), not the played note. Pitch envelope: +24 st falling exponentially (D 50 ms).
Amp A 0 / D 0.12 / S 0 / R 0.12 s (Welsh); a 4 ms noise click; saturation, compressor 4:1 with 10 ms attack, room with 90 ms pre-delay.
The card's multiband EQ is not built (no EQ block).

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 89, patch Snare Drum, table transcribed; layering practice: Snoman [B3] p. 441
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (triangle + noise + filter + short envelopes).

beschreibung.text: Snare: noise-dominated rattle with a short triangle body and a small pitch drop, light saturation, room and compressor.

naeherung: Welsh Snare: triangle body (fixed 180 Hz, tune knob) at a fifth of the noise level, noise dominates; body D 0.27 s, noise D 0.12 s.
Body pitch drops 3 st over about 30 ms (the card's derived drum-machine fix). The EQ cut at 200-400 Hz is not built.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 86, patch Clap
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (noise + band-limited filter + retriggered square LFO on amplitude).

beschreibung.text: Analog clap: filtered noise chopped by a retriggered 32 Hz square, short decay, high-passed plate.

naeherung: Welsh Clap: noise into the 12 dB filter the card prefers, 1.1 kHz, resonance 30 %, env 50 % (60 st) with D 0.15 s.
32 Hz square LFO on the amplitude, depth 45 %, retriggered by every hit (`neustart`), which makes the multi-hand clap.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 88, patch Cymbal note
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (six pulses + three SVF band-passes is 6 voices per hit; with 16 voices that is two simultaneous hits. The noise+high-pass fallback is cheaper but sounds like a sample-less 808).

beschreibung.text: Closed hi-hat: six inharmonic squares through three band-passes with their own short envelopes, high-passed, gated, small room.

naeherung: The metallic method: six squares at the TR-808 frequencies (205.3, 304.4, 369.6, 522.7, 540, 800 Hz; engineering values, the card gives the architecture).
Three band-passes at 3 / 6 / 10 kHz, each with its own envelope (decays 1, 0.8, 0.6 x the knob, 60 ms at the midpoint), then a high-pass.
Six oscillators are nodes inside one voice, so a hit costs one voice, not six. The gate after the EQ trims the tail.
besser_mit: metallic oscillator bank (many inharmonic square or pulse partials)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 88, patch Cymbal, table transcribed; the author's own note calls it the least realistic patch in the book.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar mit Näherung (noise + resonant high-pass + distortion reads as a cymbal in a mix; a believable ride or crash needs samples, the source itself calls it the least realistic patch in the book).

beschreibung.text: Crash-like cymbal: noise and a six-square metal layer, resonant filter, high-pass, distortion and a long hall.

naeherung: Welsh Cymbal: noise into a 24 dB ladder, cutoff 89 % = 9.0 kHz (the card's '904 Hz' is the OCR'd 9.04 kHz), resonance 50 %, env 70 %.
A six-square metallic layer is mixed with the noise (knob 3), the card's alternative; then high-pass 400 Hz, distortion and a 3 s hall.
As the card says, a believable ride or crash needs samples or a dense metallic oscillator bank.
patches.exakt_mit: metallic oscillator bank (many inharmonic square or pulse partials)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 83, patch Timpani, table transcribed; the tom/timpani distinction: Reid [B2] part 31
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar.

beschreibung.text: Analog tom: two squares a minor seventh apart with a quick pitch drop, resonant filter thump and a short room.

naeherung: Timpani [B1] p. 83 turned into a tom: squares at the tune pitch and -10 st, ladder 800 Hz / 45 % with env 35 % (42 st) D 0.35 s.
Amp D 0.6 s at the midpoint (rack tom; the card's range 0.4-0.8 s), pitch drop 5 st with a 0.1 s exponential envelope (90 % in ~33 ms).
besser_mit: modal resonator (bank of tuned resonant modes)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 85, patch Castanets, table transcribed (derived for shaker, same noise-plus-resonance structure, 40 ms decay). Role in the arrangement: Snoman [B3] p. 427
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (noise + resonant low-pass + 40 ms envelope).

beschreibung.text: Shaker: a 40 ms grain of noise ringing a resonant 7.6 kHz filter, high-passed, velocity-sensitive, tiny room.

naeherung: Castanets [B1] p. 85 retuned (the card's derivation): noise into a ladder at 7.6 kHz with resonance 100 %, a 40 ms grain.
Velocity scales the level, so alternating velocities give the shaker pattern.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 82, patch Conga, table transcribed; single-membrane acoustics: Reid [B2] part 31
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar.

beschreibung.text: Conga: two squares a ninth apart with a quick filter slap and a 150 ms decay, short room and compressor.

naeherung: Welsh Conga: squares at the tune pitch and +1 oct +2 st (the second at 0.47 = -6.5 dB), ladder 300 Hz / 40 %, env 50 % (60 st) D 0.02 s S 80 %.
Amp D 0.15 s, mono. The EQ boost and cut are not built.
besser_mit: modal resonator (bank of tuned resonant modes)

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 88, patch Side Stick, table transcribed; architecture: Reid [B2] part 41
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar.

beschreibung.text: Rim shot: a 90 ms click of noise ringing a self-oscillating 2.7 kHz filter, very short room.

naeherung: Welsh Side Stick: noise into a self-oscillating ladder at 2.7 kHz (resonance 100 %), env 85 % (102 st) D 1.19 s, amp D 90 ms.
The resonant filter is the card's band-pass; very short room after it.

Measured: with the transcribed env 85 % and filter D 1.19 s the cutoff stays near the top of its range for the whole 90 ms click, so the ring sits near 11 kHz, not at 2.7 kHz. A shorter filter decay (0.19 s?) would bring it to 2.7 kHz; the OCR'd table cannot settle it.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 87, patches Cowbell and “[quote omitted]”, tables transcribed. Frequency cross-check: Reid [B2] part 41
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (two pulses, filter, 150 ms decay).

beschreibung.text: Analog cowbell: two narrow pulses at 587 and 845 Hz, a bright filter snap, 150 ms decay and a short room.

naeherung: Cowbell: pulses of 10 % and 35 % at the CR-8000's measured 587 and 845 Hz (the card's frequency cross-check) instead of Welsh's +5 st.
Ladder 8.1 kHz, env 65 % (78 st) D 0.02 s S 65 %, amp D 0.15 s; high-pass 500 Hz, short room, optional saturation.
besser_mit: metallic oscillator bank (many inharmonic square or pulse partials)

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 301
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (noise + SVF band-pass + mod envelope + hall; the wet automation must come from the well, not the synth).

beschreibung.text: Noise riser: white noise through a band-pass that sweeps up over four seconds into a long hall.

naeherung: Noise into a 12 dB band-pass a quarter open (300 Hz, resonance 25 %); a mod envelope with a 4 s attack (knob), no decay or sustain, opens it 60 st.
Amp: immediate attack, full sustain, 1.5 s release. The upward wet automation comes from the host, as the card says (the hall mix is a knob).

patches.zitat: Snoman [B3] p. 301
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (same patch as the riser with the envelope inverted; the kit's LFO/mod matrix needs negative amounts).

beschreibung.text: Noise downlifter: a band-passed noise wash that falls from bright to dark over four seconds into hall and delay.

naeherung: The riser inverted: the band-pass starts three quarters open (3.6 kHz) and the same slow envelope pulls it down 48 st (negative amount).
Hall (long) then a 1/4 delay; the downward wet automation comes from the host.

patches.zitat: derived, the source set has no impact patch. Building blocks: Snoman [B3] p. 299 (“[quote omitted]”) names the category; the pitch-fall method is the one given for the kick (p. 441) and the pitched riser (p. 302); the body is Welsh's Bass Drum [B1] p. 85.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (sine + pitch envelope + heavy saturation + long hall).

beschreibung.text: Cinematic impact: a sine boom falling an octave and a half, noise debris, heavy saturation and a long hall.

naeherung: Sine body (60 Hz, tune knob) with a pitch fall of 18 st over ~200 ms (exponential, D 0.2 s), body D 1.2 s; noise debris band-passed at 1 kHz, D 0.12 s.
Heavy saturation, hall (6 s, 45 ms pre-delay), limiter. The reversed crash layer needs a sample and is left out; the EQ is not built.
The slow LFO on the reverb wet is left out: the hall mix must stay on a knob (convention).

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 108, patch Ocean Waves, table transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (noise + slow LFO on amplitude + hall).

beschreibung.text: Ocean wind: filtered noise swelling slowly at 0.2 Hz, long hall, high- and low-passed.

naeherung: Ocean Waves [B1] p. 108: noise into a 24 dB ladder at 4.3 kHz, resonance 30 %, amp A 0.4 / R 1.0 s.
LFO triangle 0.2 Hz, depth 75 % on the amplitude (the level swings between 25 % and 100 %). The optional chorus and the foghorn saw are left out.

patches.zitat: Welsh [B1] p. 108, patch Nerd-O-Tron 2000, table transcribed.
patches.machbarkeit_karte: baubar (saw + square + resonant filter + noise-shaped LFO; random LFO is the one thing to check in the kit's LFO list).

beschreibung.text: Machine texture bed: saw and square two octaves apart, a resonant filter wandering at random, phaser, delay and spring.

naeherung: Nerd-O-Tron 2000 [B1] p. 108: saw plus square at +2 oct, ladder 680 Hz / 85 %, amp R 2 s; each layer is a wavetable with 3 copies (+-12 cent) for width.
'Noise as LFO source': a random (S&H) LFO at 0.9 Hz smoothed over 100 ms, depth 25 % = +-15 st on the cutoff.
Phaser, 1/4 delay with 40 % feedback, convolution with the spring impulse `feder-ir.f32` (a short metallic IR from proben.rs), high-pass.
